notes: Phase 3D decisions D1-D7 (docs/PROGRAM_SCREEN_PHASE_3D_CALFIRE_SRA_PACKAGE.md). This package establishes the PRC section 4202 route only; GOV section 51178 is neither captured nor registered.

The package never determines a lot: a lot result needs a reviewed legal-lot geometry compared deterministically with the pinned overlay dataset. Partial overlap stays unknown, and land with no SRA feature (FRA or LRA) is unknown, never a NO.
The map date (2023-09-29, dated), the adoption date (2024-01-31), and the effective date (2024-04-01) are kept separate. The map date is never relabeled as issued or adopted.
The dataset's classes are its FHSZ_Descr labels. Its numeric FHSZ code (3 Very High, 2 High, 1 Moderate) is never semantic authority; the map legend numbers the same classes in the opposite order.
